data.name: ComingNext2
data.value: For collectors: more names to pick from, a log of each new leaf on a variegated plant, how many generations a cutting is from your oldest plant, and orders that brought several plants at once.

data.name: ComingNext3
data.value: Photos: share a photo from your gallery straight to a plant on Android, line up a new photo with the last one, and mark the plants on a photo of a shelf.

data.name: ComingNext4
data.value: Everyday shortcuts: water or add a note with a long press on a plant, reservoir and flushing for plants in LECA or PON, and which of your outer pots a nursery pot fits in.

data.name: ComingNext5
data.value: Showing it off: a plant's anniversary on Today, an experiment's result as a picture to post, your year as a video, and a plant's story to print.

data.name: ComingNext6
data.value: When something is wrong: a check of what you see on a plant with what to look at next, and short guides that work offline.

data.name: ComingNext7
data.value: Naming a plant from a photo, a card with facts about its species, and a page to show your collection to others.
